Observations & Corrective Actions

23: 3-501.17 Refrigerated, ready-to-eat food(s) that require time or temperature control for safety was not discarded within 7 days of preparation or opening of product. Corrective Action (CA)- the operator will implement a date marking system.

36: 4-302.12 A food thermometer, capable of reading food temperatures required by the code, was not available for use. CA- the operator will order a probe thermometer.

39: 3-305.11 Food was not stored at least 6 inches above the floor. The inspector observed a bag of onions and a case of chicken stored on the floor in the walk in cooler. CA- all food must be stored 6 inches off the floor throughout the facility.

48: 4-302.14 A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration of sanitizing solution was not available at time of inspection. CA- the operator will order chlorine test strips.
